de.AvatarSkin_Alice_Desc_000: Die perfekte Symmetrie der jungen Dame wird nur leicht beeinträchtigt, wenn sie ihr Schulemblem trägt. Dies ist das elegante und edle Gemüt der Thymefields.
de.AvatarSkin_Alice_Desc_001:
Obwohl es nicht ganz symmetrisch war, störte sie sich nicht an diesem Geschenk einer lieben Freundin.
Das Mädchen öffnet die verschlossene Tür und läuft nach einem plötzlichen Regenschauer entlang eines rosafarbenen Strands. Die kühlen Wellen kitzeln ihre Knöchel. Es gibt keine Mysterien mehr, die sie erschrecken können.
de.AvatarSkin_Anbi_Desc_000: Diese Alltagskleidung wurde von Nicole persönlich für Anby ausgesucht und gestylt. Sie ist dafür gedacht, sich leicht bewegen zu können, und auch ideal für Straßenaktivitäten. Der Stoff und das Zubehör haben mehr gekostet, als es scheint, daher geht Anby sehr vorsichtig mit ihrem Outfit um.
de.AvatarSkin_Anton_Desc_000: Das Surren des Presslufthammers ertönt unentwegt – ein Echo des heißen, donnernden Herzschlags seines Trägers.
de.AvatarSkin_Aokaku_Desc_000: Sie schwingt eine Schwertflagge, halb so groß wie eine Person, während ihr Magen harmonisch im Takt grummelt. Raschel, raschel, raschel – schon ist die Arbeit getan! Zeit, nach Hause zu gehen und zu Abend zu essen!
de.AvatarSkin_Aria_Desc_000: Ein Hauch von pink und weiß, ein bisschen Licht und Schallwellen, dazu zahllose Tage und Nächte, die dem Gesang gewidmet wurden – auf der Bühne kommt all das als grenzenlose Fantasie zusammen.
de.AvatarSkin_Aria_Desc_001:
Arias Auftrittsoutfit für besondere Shows, das sie nur ein paar Mal getragen hat.
Ein schneeweißer „Engel“, gekleidet in die Flügel eines „Dämons“. Atme tief durch, mach dich bereit ... Sobald die Scheinwerfer angehen, ist es Zeit für die Rebellion der „Angels of Delusion“!
de.AvatarSkin_Astra_Desc_000: Das feurige Rot entfacht die Freiheit tief im Herzen. Auf der Bühne kann nichts ihre Brillanz in den Schatten stellen.
de.AvatarSkin_Astra_Desc_001: Das schwarz-weiße Kleid funkelt sowohl im Licht als auch im Schatten. Ihr Lächeln scheint eins mit dem fließenden Licht der Nacht und zu einem zeitlosen Klassiker zu werden.
de.AvatarSkin_Azural_Desc_000: Eine zuckersüße Stimme kommt aus dem Hörer. Wenn du dich näher heran lehnst, um sie zu hören, wird sie zu einem sanften Flüstern, das ankündigt, dass das Urteil gefällt wurde ... Nur ein Witz. Das ist bloß eine standardmäßige Zufriedenheitsumfrage.
de.AvatarSkin_BanYue_Desc_000: Er strahlt eine rechtschaffene, unerschütterliche Aura aus, ganz wie es sich für einen Meister seines Kalibers gehört. Verurteile seine Stille nicht, denn ein steinernes Herz macht kein Geräusch und Barmherzigkeit spricht nicht laut.
de.AvatarSkin_Belle_Desc_000: Ich bin die Chefin, nicht die Assistentin. Eine energiegeladene junge Frau mit geheimer Identität!
de.AvatarSkin_Belle_Desc_001: Macht fließt mit Leichtigkeit, Sterne tanzen anmutig. Ich, Belle, Schülerin des Yunkuigipfels, erweise meine Ehre!
de.AvatarSkin_Belle_Desc_002: Wellen kitzeln ihre Beine. Sonnenstrahlen stehlen sich durch ihre Hutkrempe. Das Meer und die Sterne, das ist der Weg einer jungen Frau!
de.AvatarSkin_Belle_Desc_003: Fege durch die Nacht wie ein Phantom auf der silbernen Leinwand. Einen Moment lang flackert das Universum, während Morgenröte und Abenddämmerung zu deinem unveränderten Heimweg zusammenfließen.
de.AvatarSkin_Ben_Desc_000: Wenn man sein furchteinflößendes Äußeres wegnimmt, das Außenstehende einschüchtern soll, sieht man, dass selbst der Bestienkönig Probleme damit hat, sein Fell zu pflegen und Rechnungen zu sortieren.
de.AvatarSkin_Billy_Desc_000: Stil ist Gerechtigkeit. Gerechtigkeit ist Stil. Dies ist das ewige Glaubensbekenntnis eines wahren Ritters! Aber ... ja, diese Gelenkschrauben nutzen sich echt schnell ab ...
de.AvatarSkin_Brujas_Desc_000: Eine Seele zweier gespiegelter Hälften, die zweimal den Fluss der Toten überquert haben. Eine Seite wurde in Feuer geschmiedet, die andere aus Eis geformt. Die eine blickt zu ihrem Ursprung zurück, die andere zu einem neuen Morgen. Sie wandern weiter, nie verloren, nie still.
de.AvatarSkin_Burnice_Desc_000:
Ein Outfit, das heißer als Nitro-Fuel brennt. Wer zu einer Party in der Außenzone geht, wird höchstwahrscheinlich Burnice antreffen, sollte jedoch ihre Spezialgetränke mit Vorsicht genießen ...
Oh, du hast bereits einen Schluck getrunken? Nun, dann ... 3, 2, 1, Feuer!
de.AvatarSkin_Caesar_Desc_000: Eine Herrscherin, die bereit ist, die triumphale Hymne erneut erklingen zu lassen. Eine Heldin, darauf erpicht, ihre Legende neu zu entfachen. Diese noch etwas unreife Anführerin hat sich endlich den Flammen ihrer Krönung gestellt, doch sie geht noch immer im groben Sand der Außenzone. Zupfe zart die Saiten an und schon breitet sich ihre Melodie der Wüste über dieses Land aus, das die Last der Hoffnung trägt.
de.AvatarSkin_Cissia_Desc_000:
Es gibt zwei Arten von Menschen auf dieser Welt: Giftschlangen und Mäuse! Und wer was ist ...
Prinzessin Cissia sagt: Wer stärker ist als ich, ist eine Schlange, und wer schwächer ist, ist eine Maus!
de.AvatarSkin_Clara_Desc_000: Lass dich vom trägen Blick dieser LKW-Fahrerin nicht täuschen. Ein kleiner Tritt aufs Gaspedal und schon wird die Seele eines jeden Passagiers auf den Rücksitz gerissen.
de.AvatarSkin_Corin_Desc_000: Ihr zierlicher Körperbau strahlt überraschende Stärke aus und das Getöse der Kettensäge übertönt ihr zaghaftes Schluchzen. Diesem stets artigen und professionellen Dienstmädchen fehlt es immer an Selbstvertrauen ... also lass dir einen Moment Zeit, um auf sie zu warten.
de.AvatarSkin_Ellen_Desc_000: Die scharfen Scheren von Victoria Housekeeping Co. Wenn sie doch nur nicht schlafen würde ...
de.AvatarSkin_Ellen_Desc_001: Ihr Fischschwanz passt nicht ganz zur Schuluniform, aber mit ein paar Näharbeiten wird es nur noch niedlicher!
de.AvatarSkin_Evelyn_Desc_000: Pfiffige, nüchterne Agentenkleidung, doch der verborgene Biss reicht aus, um Schaulustige zu verscheuchen. Ihre goldbraunen Haare weben ein feines, zartes Netz, in dem ein stiller Teich aus Sternenglanz zu ruhen scheint.
de.AvatarSkin_Harumasa_Desc_000: Seine Augen sind klarer als das leuchtende Gelb an seiner Stirn. Seine Pfeile durchbohren Täuschung und Lügen und die Vergangenheit zerstreut sich wie Federn im Wind. Die Morgendämmerung mag noch nicht gekommen sein, doch hinter dem Horizont glänzt schwach eine goldene Zukunft.
de.AvatarSkin_HugoVlad_Desc_000: Lass dich nie vom Schicksal fesseln. Wehre dich gegen seine Schellen, seine Kontrolle, seinen Spott, seine Almosen, seine Flüche und seine sogenannten Segnungen. Sobald der Abgrund erobert wurde, ist es das Schicksal, das niederknien sollte.
de.AvatarSkin_JaneDoe_Desc_000: Ihr alltägliches Outfit, wenn sie mal keine Verkleidung trägt. Vielleicht ist es nur eines der tausend Gesichter, die sie trägt. Die Nacht gibt ihr Deckung und ihre Maske ist die einzige Wahrheit, die sie nie ablegt.
de.AvatarSkin_JaneDoe_Desc_001: Wer sagt, dass ein Strandspaziergang von Sonnenschein begleitet werden muss? Für namenlose Beobachter ist die Nacht der getreuste Gefährte. Die anonyme Dame sagt, das nächtliche Meer trägt unsägliche Geheimnisse in sich ... Ist das die Wahrheit oder nur eine weitere Täuschung?
de.AvatarSkin_Jufufu_Desc_000: Diese Seniorschülerin ist wie eine einfache Mystikerin gekleidet und sieht aus, als hätte sie all ihren Wagemut verborgen. Doch in ihrem Herzen lauert ein Tiger, und ihr heldenhaftes Feuer sickert weiterhin durch.
de.AvatarSkin_Lighter_Desc_000: Der Oberchampion nimmt seine Sonnenbrille nie ab ... und auch nicht seinen Schal. Ruhm bedeutet ihm schon lange nichts mehr, doch es lohnt sich immer noch, auf die unzähligen Abenddämmerungen, die er mit seinen Gefährten geteilt hat, zu warten.
de.AvatarSkin_Lisa_Desc_000: Eine saubere Uniform ohne Schnickschnack. Was dieses Mechanikgenie am meisten liebt, sind die vielen großen und kleinen Außentaschen, die alle perfekt zum Aufbewahren von Schrauben, Zahnrädern und sogar Schraubenschlüsseln aller Größenordnungen sind.
de.AvatarSkin_Longinus_Desc_000: Die Schutzbrille in warmen Farbtönen kann ihren eisigen Soldatenblick nicht verbergen. Willst du sie lächeln sehen? Du hast die Wahl zwischen 87,5 einhändige Liegestütze oder eine Schüssel superscharfer Nudeln.
de.AvatarSkin_Lucia_Desc_000: Ihr Umhang ist der Vorhang der Nacht und unter ihrer Kapuze ruht das leise Geflüster der Welt. Sie singt für die Abenddämmerung und spricht in Träumen. Sie sammelt die von den Schlafenden zurückgelassenen Gedanken und webt sie zu Heiligenscheinen und Rätseln am Sternenhimmel.
de.AvatarSkin_Lucy_Desc_000:
Nach Biker-Maßstäben ist ihr Outfit recht fein gefertigt, doch es wirkt Wunder bei Verhandlungen mit Außenseitern.
Diese ausgerissene Prinzessin hat in der Außenzone ihre Freiheit gefunden. Sie glänzt im nächtlichen Sternenlicht, brennt am Rande der Abenddämmerung, und ruht still inmitten der Sandkörner zu ihren Füßen.
de.AvatarSkin_Lucy_Name_000: Lucy: Dame mit der eisernen Faust
de.AvatarSkin_Lycaon_Desc_000: Mit makelloser Haltung steht der Bedienstete im reinen Mondlicht. Doch wenn der rote Mond aufgeht, kommt seine unter der Abendkleidung verborgene, wilde Natur zum Vorschein, mit ihrer ganz eigenen Contenance und Eleganz.
de.AvatarSkin_NangongYu_Desc_000:
Träume sind sowohl billig als auch teuer und immer außer Reichweite. Auf der Erde werden die von den Leuten als Sterne bezeichnet.
Also wandert der Engel inmitten der Sterne und nimmt einen Hauch von Wunschdenken aus der endlosen Galaxie mit – das allererste Regenbogenlicht, das auf sie niederschien.
de.AvatarSkin_NangongYu_Desc_001:
Sie tanzt in ungeordneten Rhythmen, wirbelt über eine Bühne wilder Fantasie.
Die Grenze zwischen Engel und Dämon verschwimmt mit dem Licht, löst sich in ihrem Spiegelbild auf.
de.AvatarSkin_Nicole_Desc_000: Klassisches Outfit der Anführerin der Cunning Hares mit einem Hauch von verspielter List, sowohl verschmitzt als auch niedlich.
de.AvatarSkin_Nicole_Desc_001: Pink! Pink! Pink! Pink ist Nicoles Farbe. Macht das Freude?
de.AvatarSkin_Norano_Desc_000:
Die Standardbekleidung des inoffiziellen Streitschlichters der Sailume-Bucht reicht aus, um Gelegenheitsschurken einzuschüchtern.
Doch manchmal zieht sie auch schielende Augen auf sich.
de.AvatarSkin_Norano_Desc_001:
Der junge Manato schwor sich einen einzelgängerischen Eid und so entstand aus seinen Träumereien ein einsamer, blasser Schatten.
In dieser Nachahmung seiner Kleidung wirkt Manato sogar noch einschüchternder.
de.AvatarSkin_Norma_Desc_000: Erste Regel der Sicherheitsrichtlinien für Normas Labor: Kritik und Ratschläge von Idioten und Stümpern meiden.
de.AvatarSkin_OokumaMari_Desc_000: Eine feuerrote Gestalt schwingt Zwillingshämmer, als könnte sie die Zeit selbst zerschmettern. Sie ist so jung – ihre Reise hat eben erst begonnen. Doch Erwachsenwerden kann warten, denn zu guter Letzt wird jede Person zu ihrem wahren Selbst.
de.AvatarSkin_PanYinhu_Desc_000: Die Schüleruniform des Yunkuigipfels in größter Größe ist nötig, um den Wanst dieses Seniorschülers sowie all seine Gewürze unterzubringen. Sein eiserner Wok als Hut ist wirklich einzigartig, doch ... wieso setzt er eine Pfanne, die zum Anbraten verwendet wird, auf seinen Kopf? Das brennt doch, oder?
de.AvatarSkin_PanYinhu_Desc_001:
Seniorschüler Yinhu träumte einst davon, ein berühmter Chefkoch zu werden, aber in dieser Welt gibt es immer Schurken, die dir deine Töpfe und Pfannen zerschlagen wollen.
– „Mach ruhig. Versuche, einen zu zerschlagen.“
de.AvatarSkin_Promeia_Desc_000: Dunkelheit ist eine Waffe, die perfekt in ihre Hand passt. Für sie als Vollstreckerin ist die Nacht ihr Zuhause, doch ihre schweren Fesseln führen sie leicht auf Irrwege.
de.AvatarSkin_Pulchra_Desc_000: Eine wandernde Söldnerin sollte draußen sein und die Welt bereisen, doch das Sonnenlicht hier ist so schön warm – perfekt für ein Nickerchen.
de.AvatarSkin_Pyrois_Desc_000: Das sterbende Hitzeflimmern, das im Tal erlosch, wird eines Tages aus dem Meer wiedergeboren. Die Bestie, die das Schicksal unter ihren Füßen zertrampelte, wird zum Streitwagen, der den Weg nach vorn freimacht.
de.AvatarSkin_QingYi_Desc_000: Hab immer eine getreue Wasserflasche dabei und trink viel heißes Wasser – diese uralte Weisheit stammt aus den Zeiten der alten Zivilisation, doch wieso würde ein intelligentes Konstrukt Tee trinken? Muss der Gesundheit dienen ... oder?
de.AvatarSkin_RemielleOrigin_Desc_000:
Ein Engel von einst fiel zur Welt der Sterblichen herab. Ihre Federn schwebten hinunter, als sie in einem tiefen Schlummer versank.
Erwache aus dem farblosen Einöde, jenseits der Grenze allen Klangs, und beginne die Reise von Neuem.
de.AvatarSkin_RemielleOrigin_Desc_001:
Da die Sonne uns nie Gnade erwiesen hat, lass uns den Fall zusammen mit der vom Mondlicht erleuchteten Nacht umarmen.
Du sagst, es ist schwierig, zwischen Witz und Trug zu unterscheiden?
Dann lass uns eine weitere Runde unserer Frage-Antwort-Spiels spielen, {M#mein lieber Komplize}{F#meine liebe Komplizin}.
de.AvatarSkin_RemielleOrigin_Desc_002: Ursprünglich war dies ein Solotanz, doch ein Lichtstrahl hat die in Dunkelheit gehüllten Geheimnisse und Einsamkeit erhellt. Nun, würdest du mit mir einen Pas de deux tanzen, {M#mein lieber Komplize}{F#meine liebe Komplizin}?
de.AvatarSkin_Rina_Desc_000: Ihr Rock ist tadellos, ihr Erscheinungsbild einwandfrei gelassen. Dies sind die Perfektionsansprüche des Hauptdienstmädchens. Doch in der Küche scheint ihre Auffassung von „Perfektion“ etwas gänzlich anderes zu sein ...
de.AvatarSkin_SPBilly_Desc_000: Wer stets an die Hoffnung glaubt, wird am Ende zur Hoffnung eines anderen.
de.AvatarSkin_Seed_Desc_000: Eine Ecke der Welt erblüht farbenfroh, eine einzelne salzige Träne fällt, ein perfekter Kreis des Lebens – dort haben das Mädchen und das Konstrukt die Wahrheit ihrer Herzen erkannt. Sie muss nie zurückblicken, denn sie ist bereits in ihrem eigenen Blumenmeer erblüht.
de.AvatarSkin_Seth_Desc_000: Er mag zwar etwas schwer von Begriff sein – noch schwerer als der Schild in seiner linken Hand –, doch sein Gespür für Böses ist auch schlagkräftiger als der Schlagstock in seiner rechten.
de.AvatarSkin_Sigrid_Desc_000: Die Standarduniform des Vizeoberhaupts der Luftraumpatrouillenabteilung. Sie dient sowohl als Symbol ihrer Befehlsgewalt über die Abteilung als auch für sie als Ikone, die in unzähligen Geschichten verewigt ist.
de.AvatarSkin_Sigrid_Desc_001: Eine Ritterin, die es gewohnt ist, durch den Himmel zu galoppieren, muss sich nun der neuen Herausforderung der Wellen und Sonne stellen!
de.AvatarSkin_SilverAnby_Desc_000:
Anbys alte Silber-Truppe-Uniform ist von Erinnerungen befleckt, die nie wirklich verblasst sind.
Wenn die Schatten der Vergangenheit ohne Vorwarnung zuschlagen, steh aufrecht und stell dich ihnen, oder stolpere und fliehe. Egal, was du wählst, es wird immer ein Zuhause auf dich warten.
de.AvatarSkin_Summer_Desc_000: Solange sie die süßesten Kleider trägt, die sie sich vorstellen kann, kann sie den Menschenmassen entkommen und sich im Echo des Wunschdenkens verstecken.
de.AvatarSkin_Summer_Desc_001:
Ofenfrischer Kuchen, aromatischer Kaffee und die warme Nachmittagssonne ...
Inmitten dieser sanften Momente beginnt die heutige Teepause.
de.AvatarSkin_Trigger_Desc_000: In den Höhlen trifft sie stets in Schwarze. Sie ist ein Truppenmitglied, auf das ohne Frage Verlass ist, doch sobald sie daheim auf der Sixth Street ist, mildert sich ihre stetige Wachsamkeit und verweilt nur einen Moment, ehe sie verschwindet, sobald sie bemerkt wird.
de.AvatarSkin_Tsubaki_Desc_000: Eine verirrte Katze weiß nicht, wohin sie gehen soll, nur, dass sie weitergehen muss. Sie wanderte durch die weitläufigen Straßen von New Eridu, ohne jeglichen Schutz vor dem Wetter durch ihre dünne Kleidung, bis eine gewisse klitzekleine, allmächtige Agentur sie letztendlich aufnahm.
de.AvatarSkin_Unagi_Desc_000: Eine Klinge, die die Höhle durchschneidet. Ein Leuchtturm, der den Nebel durchbohrt. Die Leute hoffen auf eine Kämpferin, die die Welt verbessert, und auf eine Steuerfrau, die den Kurs setzt, auf Fahnen, die nie aufhören zu wehen, und Ehre, die ewig anhält. Doch Macht ist begrenzt. Training ist die einzige Konstante.
de.AvatarSkin_Unagi_Desc_001:
Wenn Blumen zu blühen beginnen und Frost den silbernen Hof bestäubt, zieht sich die junge Dame in eine stille Ecke zurück, wann immer Gäste sich versammeln. Mit gesenktem Blick und einem Buch in der Hand, sagt sie sanft Verse lang vergangener Zeiten auf.
Gäste überschütten sie mit Lob – der Hoshimi-Klan bleibt Traditionen weiter treu und ist so würdevoll und kultiviert wie eh und je.
Nur Souichirou steht in der Nähe, mit einem fast unmerklichen, amüsierten Grinsen in seinen Augen. Er weiß besser als alle anderen, dass seine Tochter die wahre Bedeutung des Gedichts vermutlich nicht mal zur Hälfte versteht.
de.AvatarSkin_Velina_Desc_000: Einige Wichtigtuer behaupten, die Verwaltungsleiterin hätte abgelehnt, die offizielle Uniform der AES zu tragen, um ihre prestigeträchtige Herkunft zur Schau zu stellen. Doch Velina hatte noch nie viel Interesse an verschwenderischer Mode. Statt des kunstvollen Glamours traditioneller Aufmachungen, sind ihr einfache Kleider lieber – schnittig, angemessen und für die nie enden wollenden Verwaltungsaufgaben geeignet.
de.AvatarSkin_Velina_Desc_001: Außerhalb der Arbeit lädt Velina ihre engen Freunde manchmal zum Nachmittagstee ein. Während solcher Momente zieht sie es vor, ein eher legeres Outfit zu tragen, um ihre Freizeit zu genießen. Für Bangboos ist sie jedoch weiterhin die Sensenfrau – nur in einer anderen gruseligen Verkleidung.
de.AvatarSkin_Vivian_Desc_000:
Wahre deine Eleganz, Fräulein Vivian. Vom Endpunkt deines Schirms bis hin zu deinem wallenden Rock.
Wahre deinen Mut, Fräulein Vivian. Beim einsamen Spaziergang gestern Nacht, oder heute hier an meiner Seite.
de.AvatarSkin_Vivian_Desc_001: Vögel erheben sich in den sternenbedeckten Himmel und am Teich blühen Iris. Obwohl diese bezaubernde Nacht im Mondschein kurz sein mag, lass mich bitte die verweilende Vorfreude in deinen Augen sehen, wenn ich erblühe.
de.AvatarSkin_WiseAndBelle_Desc_002: Das Strandoutfit des Proxys kann im Proxy-Outfit-Menü angelegt werden.
de.AvatarSkin_WiseAndBelle_Story_002: Das Set „Wogen und Himmel“ enthält das Outfit „Wise – Ruhige Wogen“ sowie das Outfit „Belle – Sommerhimmel“.
de.AvatarSkin_Wise_Desc_000: Das klassische Outfit des legendären Proxys. Los geht’s auf einen Spaziergang in Ridu.
de.AvatarSkin_Wise_Desc_001: Macht fließt mit Leichtigkeit, himmlisches Licht umgibt mich. Ich, Wise, Schüler des Yunkuigipfels, erweise meine Ehre.
de.AvatarSkin_Wise_Desc_002: Ein Spaziergang durch die sanfte Meeresbrise. Sommer bedeutet immerhin Strand, Wellen und eiskalte Wassermelone!
de.AvatarSkin_Wise_Desc_003: Spring in den Himmel, wie die Hauptfigur eines Films. Einen Moment lang erfrieren die Wolken, während heulender Wind und tosende Stürme deine unveränderliche Entschlossenheit auf die Probe stellen.
de.AvatarSkin_XiaoZhao_Desc_000: Ihre weichen, flauschigen Ohren und zierlicher Körperbau mögen zu Unterschätzung auffordern, doch diese Richterin würde nicht zweimal überlegen, ehe sie ihren Zweig auf jene niederfahren lässt, die ihr Glück versuchen.
de.AvatarSkin_Yanagi_Desc_000: Selbst ihre spiegelnde Brille kann die Klarheit in den Augen der stellvertretenden Leiterin nicht verbergen. Sie muss immerhin ständig über eine von Training besessene Kämpferin, einen immer faulenzenden Späher und ein junges Mädchen, das dauernd Magenschmerzen bekommt, aufpassen.
de.AvatarSkin_Yidhari_Desc_000: Erinnerungen an die Vergangenheit und neue Träume laufen über und laden sie dazu ein, in ihnen zu vertrinken, während sie sich auf Papier verweben. Vor ihr liegt eine leere Seite, auf die sie an der Kreuzung von Realität und Illusion die erste Zeile niederschreibt.
de.AvatarSkin_Yixuan_Desc_000: Als Anführerin des Yunkuigipfels muss man nur Kleidung und Zubehör tragen, die sich natürlich anfühlen, und seinem wahren Selbst treu bleiben.
de.AvatarSkin_Yixuan_Desc_001: Maßgeschneiderte Kleidung in Tuscheschwarz, wie ein Schatten, der sich im Nu verflüchtigt.
de.AvatarSkin_Yuzuha_Desc_000: Kannst du erkennen, was der Schirm verbirgt? Einen Tanuki, eine Falle, einen Geist oder das verschmitzte, heitere Lächeln eines Mädchens?
de.AvatarSkin_Yuzuha_Desc_001: Geistergeschichten werden nicht nur aus Schatten geboren. Das glaubst du nicht? Sieh einfach der verspielten jungen Frau in die Augen, die da im Wasser planscht. Sie wird Besitz von deinen Gedanken ergreifen, während Kama sich mit deinem Getränk davonmacht.
de.AvatarSkin_Zhenzhen_Desc_000:
Aus Wolken gewobene Seide, in deren Falten sich der Glanz einer Klinge spiegelt. Das Gewand steht klar für ihre Trägerin.
Aber wer hat dieses Kleid wirklich gewählt? War sie es ... oder ihr tieferes Ich?
de.AvatarSkin_Zhenzhen_Desc_001: Beim Bummeln durch die Straßen scheinen das sanfte Sonnenlicht und die warme Brise die nächste Begegnung willkommen zu heißen.
de.AvatarSkin_ZhuYuan_Desc_000: Diese hochgradige Anti-Aufruhr-Ausrüstung der Sicherheitsbehörde wurde speziell modifiziert, um zu Zhu Yuans Kampfstil zu passen. Die Dreifachgewinnerin des Janus-Kampfturniers und beste junge Offizierin ist jederzeit dienstbereit, um jeden Verbrecher in ihrem Weg fertigzumachen.
de.MedalName9002: Es gibt mehr als einen Detektiv!
de.MedalName9003: Die Wahrheit ist in Nihility begraben
de.TitleText_3800133: {M#Der stärkste Passagier}{F#Die stärkste Passagierin} der Außenzone
de.TitleText_3800165: Ich werde New Eridu zum Leuchten bringen
de.TitleText_3800188: Ein Strauß der Liebe für dich

en.Alice_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, Alice gains 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>.
If Alice's Anomaly Mastery exceeds 140, each additional point grants her 1.6 Anomaly Proficiency.
Upon entering the battlefield, Alice gains 300 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
en.Alice_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charge forward and slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the attack ends.
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweet Melody</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, if there are at least 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> and quickly activate a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>. After a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, if there are at least 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby, a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> can also be quickly activated by pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> within a short window, consuming 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color>.

en.Aria_UniqueSkill_06_Desc:
Aria's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>82</color>.
If Aria's 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> lands a heavy attack on an enemy suffering an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, which resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>25.2%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>13.1%</color>/<color=#FF5521>32.7%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>2.29%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>3.3%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>1.3%</color> per 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery of the original Anomaly DMG. If the target is Stunned, the DMG ratio is further increased by <color=#FFFFFF>50%</color>.
en.Aria_UniqueSkill_07_Desc:
Aria's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>90</color>.
If Aria's 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> lands a heavy attack on an enemy suffering an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, which resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>27.5%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>14.3%</color>/<color=#FF5521>35.7%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>2.5%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>3.6%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>1.4%</color> per 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery of the original Anomaly DMG. If the target is Stunned, the DMG ratio is further increased by <color=#FFFFFF>50%</color>.
en.Astra_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character:
When Energy is consumed to trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Finale</color>, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color>.
en.Astra_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after an <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> to activate:
Release an energy beam forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Astra_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Astra_Skill_Charge_Desc:
For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Chord</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when Astra Yao has <color=#FFFFFF>Chords</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can be triggered in the following situations:
· When the active character's attack hits an enemy, once per 3s.
· When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, once per 1s.
When other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> to attack. This <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack released is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to switch characters and trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> to attack. When other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, it will automatically trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>.
en.Astra_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Astra_Skill_EvadeAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Astra_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Astra_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, and restoring <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:-50+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*250,1,2}</color> HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#ffffff>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
After the skill, the next two <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assists</color> will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.
en.Astra_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
During the 3rd hit, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge, drawing enemies in and expanding the attack range for a stronger attack.
After using other skills, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to initiate the 3rd hit directly.
en.Astra_Skill_Normal_Singing_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> forward to attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
en.Astra_Skill_Normal_Singing_Exit_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> forward to attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
Upon activation of the skill, it grants Astra Yao the buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: "Graceful Andante"</color>.
With enough Energy, consumes Energy to follow up with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack released is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
en.Astra_Skill_Normal_Singing_Perfect_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Astra_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#ffffff>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
en.Astra_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Attack ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When triggered, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} allows movement in the corresponding direction.
en.Astra_Skill_Singing_Desc:
After entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.08+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.01,100,2}%</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.07+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.015,100,2}%</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color>, and pressing <IconMap:Icon_Evade> will activate a dodge. After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>.
While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths"</color>.
During this state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Finale</color>, exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state directly.
en.Astra_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly move away, then release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color>, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, and enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
During activation, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} enables movement in the direction held.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolos</color> depending on the charge duration.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.
en.Astra_UniqueSkill_01_Desc: During the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, and if Astra Yao expends Energy to release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> to attack, both Astra Yao and the incoming character's ATK are increased. The increase is equal to <color=#2BAD00>22%</color> of Astra Yao's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,200. The effect lasts for 20s and can be extended up to 30s with repeated triggers.
en.Astra_UniqueSkill_02_Desc: During the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, and when Astra Yao expends Energy to release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> to attack, both Astra Yao and the incoming character's ATK are increased. The increase is equal to <color=#2BAD00>24%</color> of Astra Yao's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,200. The effect lasts for 20s and can be extended up to 30s with repeated triggers.

en.AvatarSkin_3115813_ObtainDesc: Unlocked after obtaining the Outfit [Moonlight Whispers]
en.AvatarSkin_Alice_Desc_000: The young woman's perfect symmetry is only ever slightly compromised when she wears the school crest — such is the elegant and noble Thymefield spirit.
en.AvatarSkin_Alice_Desc_001:
Though it wasn't completely symmetrical, she did not mind this gift from a dear friend.
The girl pushed open the locked door and walked along the pink beach after the sudden downpour, the cool waves brushing over her ankles. There were no unknowns left to frighten her.
en.AvatarSkin_Anbi_Desc_000: These casual clothes were hand-picked and styled for Anby by Nicole. They're designed for easy movement and ideal for moving about the streets. The fabrics and accessories cost a lot more than they seem, so (?) Anby treats the outfit with real care.
en.AvatarSkin_Anton_Desc_000: The jackhammer's bearings rumble without pause, echoing the hot, thunderous beat of its wielder's heart.
en.AvatarSkin_Aokaku_Desc_000: Swinging a blade-banner as tall as half a person, and with a stomach rumbling with just as big a sound: fwish fwish fwish fwish fwish — work's done! Time to head home for dinner!
en.AvatarSkin_Aria_Desc_000: A touch of pink and white, a hint of lights and sound, plus countless days and nights devoted to singing — all of it comes together as a boundless delusion on stage.
en.AvatarSkin_Aria_Desc_001:
Aria's performance outfit for special shows, worn only a handful of times.
A pure-white "angel" clad in "demonic" wings. Take a deep breath, get ready... once the spotlight comes on, it's the Angels of Delusion's time to rebel.
en.AvatarSkin_Astra_Desc_000: The bold red is only to ignite the freedom deep within. On stage, nothing can overshadow her brilliance.
en.AvatarSkin_Astra_Desc_001: The black-and-white dress glimmers in both light and shadows. Every smile of hers seems to sink into the flowing light of the night, becoming a timeless classic.
en.AvatarSkin_Azural_Desc_000: A sweet voice comes from the receiver, and when you lean in to listen, it softens into a gentle whisper, announcing that the verdict has arrived... just kidding, it's just a standard satisfaction survey.
en.AvatarSkin_BanYue_Desc_000: He carries a righteous, unshakable aura — every bit the master he is. Don't judge him by his silence; a stone heart makes no sound, and compassion doesn't speak aloud either.
en.AvatarSkin_Belle_Desc_000: The store manager, not an assistant, and a spirited girl with a secret identity!
en.AvatarSkin_Belle_Desc_001: Power flows with ease, stars twirl gracefully. I, a disciple of Yunkui Summit, Belle, greet you!
en.AvatarSkin_Belle_Desc_002: The waves against her legs, sunlight slipping under the brim of her hat. A young girl's journey is the stars and the sea!
en.AvatarSkin_Belle_Desc_003: Sweep across the night like a phantom of the silver screen. The galaxy flickers for an instant, as dawn and dusk coalesce into your unchanged path home.
en.AvatarSkin_Ben_Desc_000: Ignoring the intimidating look meant to cow outsiders, even the Beast King struggles with grooming his fur and sorting out the bills.
en.AvatarSkin_Billy_Desc_000: Style is justice, justice is style. That's the eternal creed of a true knight! Though, yeah... those joint screws really do wear down fast...
en.AvatarSkin_Brujas_Desc_000: A soul of mirrored halves, having twice crossed the river of the dead. One side forged in fire, the other shaped into ice; one looking back on where it came from, the other watching for a new dawn. They wander on — never lost, never ceasing.
en.AvatarSkin_Brujas_Name_000: Orphie & Magus: Two Banks of the River
en.AvatarSkin_Burnice_Desc_000:
An outfit hotter than any Nitro-Fuel. Wander into a party in the Outer Ring, and odds are you'll bump into Burnice... but drink her signature cocktails at your own risk...
Wait, you've already taken a sip? Well then — 3, 2, 1... fire!
en.AvatarSkin_Caesar_Desc_000:
A ruler ready to ready to sound the triumphal anthem anew, a hero poised to reignite her legend. The not-yet-seasoned leader has finally met the flames of her coronation, yet she still walks the gritty sands of the Outer Ring.
A light tap on the piano keys sends her desert-tinged song drifting across this land that bears the weight of hope.
en.AvatarSkin_Cissia_Desc_000:
There are two kinds of people in this world, venomous snakes and mice! As for who is what...
Lady Cissia says: Those stronger than me are snakes, and those weaker than me are mice!
en.AvatarSkin_Clara_Desc_000: Don't be fooled by this truck driver's lazy gaze. One tap on the gas is enough to fling every passenger's soul straight into the back seat.
en.AvatarSkin_Corin_Desc_000: From that small frame bursts surprising strength, her roaring chainsaw drowning out her soft whimpers. The well-behaved, ever-professional maid is always short on confidence... so take a moment to wait for her.
en.AvatarSkin_Ellen_Desc_000: The sharp scissors of Victoria Housekeeping, if only she weren't sleeping...
en.AvatarSkin_Ellen_Desc_001: The tail doesn't quite match the school uniform, but with just a little bit of needlework, it can become even cuter!
en.AvatarSkin_Evelyn_Desc_000: A sharp, no-nonsense manager's outfit. Its hidden edges are enough to make onlookers back off. Her yellow-brown hair weaves a fine, delicate net, where a quiet pool of starlight seems to rest.
en.AvatarSkin_Harumasa_Desc_000: His eyes are brighter than the streak of bright yellow upon his brow. His arrows pierce through deceit and lies and scatter the past like feathers on the wind. Dawn may not have arrived yet, but beyond the horizon, a golden future shimmers faintly.
en.AvatarSkin_HugoVlad_Desc_000: Never be claimed by fate. Defy its clamps, its control, its taunts, its alms, its curses, and its so-called blessings. Once you return from the abyss, it is fate that should kneel to you.
en.AvatarSkin_JaneDoe_Desc_000: Her everyday look when she isn't putting on a disguise. Maybe it's just one of the countless faces she wears. The night becomes her cover, and her mask is the one truth she never sets aside.
en.AvatarSkin_JaneDoe_Desc_001: Who says sunlight must accompany a seaside stroll? For lurkers with names unknown, the night is their most faithful companion. The anonymous lady says the evening sea holds unspeakable secrets — is this the truth, or another deception?
en.AvatarSkin_Jufufu_Desc_000: Dressed like a simple mystic, this senior sister looks like she's tucked all her bravado away, but with a tiger in her heart... she still radiates that heroic fire.
en.AvatarSkin_Lighter_Desc_000: The undefeated champion never takes off his sunglasses... or his scarf. Glory stopped mattering long ago, but the countless dusks shared with his companions are still worth waiting for.
en.AvatarSkin_Lisa_Desc_000: A clean, no-nonsense work uniform. What the genius mechanic loves most are the many pockets on the outside — big ones, small ones — all perfect for holding screws, gears, and even wrenches of every size.
en.AvatarSkin_Longinus_Desc_000: Those warm-toned goggles can't hide her icy, soldier's gaze. Want to see her crack a smile? Pick one: 87.5 one-arm push-ups or a bowl of extra-spicy noodles.
en.AvatarSkin_Lucia_Desc_000: Her cloak is the curtain of night, and beneath her hood rests the world's quiet whispers. She sings for the dusk and speaks in dreams, gathering the thoughts sleepers leave behind and weaving them into halos and riddles across the stars.
en.AvatarSkin_Lucy_Desc_000:
Her outfit is considered rather polished by biker standards and said to work wonders in negotiations with outsiders.
The runaway princess found her freedom in the Outer Ring, glittering under the starlit night, burning at the edge of dusk, and resting quietly among the grains of sand at her feet.
en.AvatarSkin_Lycaon_Desc_000: Under the clear moonlight, the attendant's poise is flawless. Yet with the red moon's ascent, the feral nature hidden beneath this suit emerges with a composure and grace all its own.
en.AvatarSkin_NangongYu_Desc_000:
Dreams are both cheap and expensive, always just out of reach. The people on the ground call them stars.
So the angel walks among the stars and lifts a sliver of fantasy from the endless galaxy... the very first rainbow light that shone upon her.
en.AvatarSkin_NangongYu_Desc_001:
Dancing within disordered rhythms, spinning across a stage of wild fantasia.
The boundary between angel and demon tilts with the lights, dissolving within her reflection.
en.AvatarSkin_Nicole_Desc_000: The classic outfit of the leader of the Cunning Hares, hiding a hint of playful cunning, both mischievous and cute.
en.AvatarSkin_Nicole_Desc_001: Pink! Pink! Pink! Pink is Nicole's signature color. So are you feeling it?
en.AvatarSkin_Norano_Desc_000:
The standard attire of the unofficial mediator in Sailume Bay, enough to intimidate petty thugs.
Still, it sometimes draws wandering eyes.
en.AvatarSkin_Norano_Desc_001:
A young Manato made a solitary vow to himself — and from his deep reverie, a lone pale shadow was born.
Mimicking his attire enhances Manato's already exceedingly intimidating presence.
en.AvatarSkin_Norma_Desc_000: Rule #1 of Norma's Lab Safety Guidelines: Avoid criticism and advice from idiots and incompetents.
en.AvatarSkin_OokumaMari_Desc_000:
A crimson figure swings twin hammers as if she could even shatter time itself.
Still young, her journey is only just beginning. Growing up can wait; in the end, every person becomes their own true self.
en.AvatarSkin_PanYinhu_Desc_000: Yunkui Summit's largest disciple uniform, spacious enough for this senior brother's belly and all his seasonings. And that iron wok on top is a first of its kind. But... putting a pan you just used for stir-frying on your head? Doesn't it burn?
en.AvatarSkin_PanYinhu_Desc_001:
Senior Yinhu once dreamed of becoming a renowned chef, but in this day and age, there's always some thug looking to smash your bowl.
—"Go on, try smashing one."
en.AvatarSkin_Promeia_Desc_000: Darkness is a weapon that fits perfectly in my hand. As an executioner, I'm already at home in the night, but carrying heavy shackles, it's easy to lose my way.
en.AvatarSkin_Pulchra_Desc_000: A wandering mercenary should be out roaming the world, but the sunlight here is warm — perfect for a nap.
en.AvatarSkin_Pulchra_Name_000: Pulchra: Rest for a Weary Tail
en.AvatarSkin_Pyrois_Desc_000: The dying heat haze extinguished within the valley will one day be reborn from the sea. The beast that trampled fate beneath its feet will become the chariot that clears the path ahead.
en.AvatarSkin_QingYi_Desc_000: Keep your teapot close and drink plenty of hot water — that's ancient wisdom passed down from the old civilization. But why would an intelligent construct drink tea? It must be for health purposes... right?
en.AvatarSkin_RemielleOrigin_Desc_000:
An angel of old fell to the mortal world, their feathers drifting down as they sank into silent slumber.
Awaken from the pale wasteland, beyond the edge of all sound, and begin the journey anew.
en.AvatarSkin_RemielleOrigin_Desc_001:
Since the sun has never shown mercy, let us embrace the fall alongside the moonlit night.
You say it's difficult to differentiate between jokes and deception?
Then let's have another round of our Q&A game, my dear partner in crime.
en.AvatarSkin_RemielleOrigin_Desc_002: This was originally a solo dance, yet a ray of light has illuminated the secrecy and solitude shrouded in darkness. Now, would you care to join me for a pas de deux, my partner in crime?
en.AvatarSkin_Rina_Desc_000: Her skirt is immaculate and her appearance flawlessly composed — such is the head maid's standard of perfection. Yet in the kitchen, her definition of "perfect" appears to be something else entirely...
en.AvatarSkin_SPBilly_Desc_000: Those who always believe in hope will, in the end, become someone else's hope.
en.AvatarSkin_Seed_Desc_000: A corner of the world blooming in color, a single salty tear, a perfect circle of life — this is where the girl and the construct uncovered the truth of the heart. She never needs to look back; she has already blossomed into her own sea of petals.
en.AvatarSkin_Seth_Desc_000: He may be slow to pick up on things, slower even than the weight of the shield in his left hand, but his ability to detect evil is keener than the baton in his right.
en.AvatarSkin_Sigrid_Desc_000: The standard attire of the Airspace Patrol Department's Deputy Administrative Director. It serves as both a symbol of her authority over the department and an iconic figure immortalized in countless stories.
en.AvatarSkin_Sigrid_Desc_001: A knight accustomed to galloping through the skies must now face a new challenge from the waves and the sun!
en.AvatarSkin_Sigrid_Name_000: Sigrid: Legend of the Sky Island
en.AvatarSkin_SilverAnby_Desc_000:
Anby's old Silver Squad uniform, stained with memories that never truly fade.
When the shadows of the past strike without warning, would you stand and face them, or stumble and flee? No matter the choice, home always awaits your return.
en.AvatarSkin_Summer_Desc_000: Put on the outfit she finds cutest, and she can break free from the crowd, slipping into the lingering echoes of delusion.
en.AvatarSkin_Summer_Desc_001:
Freshly baked cake, rich aromatic coffee, and the warm afternoon sun...
Wrapped in moments of softness, it's time to begin today's tea break.
en.AvatarSkin_Trigger_Desc_000: In the Hollows, her aim never wavers. She's a teammate one can rely on to cover their back without question. But once she returns to Sixth Street, that constant watchfulness softens, lingering for a moment before disappearing the instant it's sensed.
en.AvatarSkin_Tsubaki_Desc_000:
A lost cat doesn't know where to go — only that it has to keep moving.
She wandered through the vast streets of New Eridu, her thin clothes offering no protection from the elements, until a tiny odd-job agency finally took her in.
en.AvatarSkin_Unagi_Desc_000: A blade that fells the Hollows, a lighthouse that pierces the fog. People hope for a fighter who hones the world and a helmsman who steers the course; for flags that never fall and honor that lives on. Yet power is finite. Only training remains constant.
en.AvatarSkin_Unagi_Desc_001:
As blooms first grace the banquet hall and frost dusts the silver courtyard, the young lady would retreat to a quiet corner whenever guests gathered — eyes downcast, book in hand, softly reciting verses from days long past.
Guests would shower them with praise: the Hoshimi Family still upheld tradition, dignified and cultured as ever.
Only Souichirou stood nearby, his eye twitching slightly — he knew better than anyone that his daughter probably didn't grasp half the poem's true meaning.
en.AvatarSkin_Velina_Desc_000: Some busybodies claim the Administrative Director rejected the External Strategy Department's official uniform to show off her prestigious upbringing, but Velina has always had little interest in lavish fashion. Rather than the elaborate glamour of ceremonial wear, she favors simple clothing: sharp, proper, and suited to dealing with never-ending administrative work.
en.AvatarSkin_Velina_Desc_001: Outside of work, Velina occasionally invites close friends to afternoon tea parties. During such moments, she changes into relatively casual attire to enjoy her free time... though to the Bangboo, it's merely the Grim Reaper in a different terrifying disguise.
en.AvatarSkin_Vivian_Desc_000: Maintain your elegance, Miss Vivian, from the point of your parasol, right down to your flowing skirt. Maintain your courage, Miss Vivian, through last night's lonely walk, or here today at my side.
en.AvatarSkin_Vivian_Desc_001: Birds soar into the starlit skies, while irises bloom by the pond. Though this enchanting moonlit night may be brief, please let me see the lingering anticipation in your eyes in the moment I bloom.
en.AvatarSkin_WiseAndBelle_Desc_002: Proxy's beach-themed outfit can be worn in the Proxy Outfit interface.
en.AvatarSkin_WiseAndBelle_Story_002: The Sunny Waves Set includes the outfit Wise: Peaceful Waves and the outfit Belle: Summer Skies.
en.AvatarSkin_Wise_Desc_000: The classic look of the legendary Proxy. Set off now and stroll through Ridu.
en.AvatarSkin_Wise_Desc_001: Power flows with ease, divine light circulates. I, Wise, a disciple of Yunkui Summit, greet you.
en.AvatarSkin_Wise_Desc_002: Strolling in the gentle sea breeze. Summer, in its essence, should be about the beach, the waves, and cold watermelon!
en.AvatarSkin_Wise_Desc_003: Leap into the sky like a movie protagonist. The clouds freeze for an instant, as howling gales and raging storms temper your unwavering resolution.
en.AvatarSkin_XiaoZhao_Desc_000: Warm, woolly ears and a small build may invite underestimation, but the Judge of "Value" won't think twice about bringing her branch down on anyone who tries.
en.AvatarSkin_Yanagi_Desc_000: Even reflective lenses can't hide the sharp gleam in the Deputy Chief's eyes. She has to constantly keep watch over a warrior obsessed with training, a scout who slacks off whenever possible, and a little one who's forever getting stomachaches.
en.AvatarSkin_Yidhari_Desc_000: Past recollections and novel dreams spill over, inviting her to drown in them as they entwine on paper. With a blank page before her, she pens the opening line at the crossroads of reality and illusion.
en.AvatarSkin_Yixuan_Desc_000: As the Master of Yunkui Summit, one's fashion and accessories need only be what feels natural. Stay true to one's self.
en.AvatarSkin_Yixuan_Desc_001: A custom attire in shades of ink. Like an elusive shadow, gone in a flash.
en.AvatarSkin_Yuzuha_Desc_000: Can you tell what the umbrella conceals? A tanuki, a trap, a ghost, or a girl's sly, spirited smile?
en.AvatarSkin_Yuzuha_Desc_001: Ghost stories aren't born only in shadows. Unconvinced? Just lock eyes with that playful young lady splashing in the water. She'll possess your thoughts, while Kama sneaks away with your drink.
en.AvatarSkin_Zhenzhen_Desc_000:
Cloud-woven silk, a blade's gleam reflected in its folds. The attire mirrors the person.
But who truly chose this dress? Was it her... or the deeper self within?
en.AvatarSkin_Zhenzhen_Desc_001: The gentle glow of sunlight and warm breeze seem to welcome your next encounter as you walk down the streets.
en.AvatarSkin_ZhuYuan_Desc_000:
This high-grade anti-riot uniform from Public Security has been specially modified to suit Zhu Yuan's fighting style.
Winner of the Janus Precinct's combat tournament three years running, the young top Public Security Officer is on call 24/7, ready to arrest any criminal in her path.
en.Azural_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character:
Dialyn's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> CRIT DMG is increased by 50%.
When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> is activated, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> effect. While <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is active, DMG dealt is increased by 40% for 15s. When Dialyn uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> while <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is active, if the remaining duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.
When a heavy attack from <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:
If the squad member is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Agent, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Agent's ATK.
If the squad member is a <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> Agent, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> Agent's Sheer Force.
en.Azural_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Performs a rapid dash followed by a slash attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Rushes forward and performs a finger flick attack, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_ExQTE_Title: Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed
en.Azural_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches a fist attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches a scissors attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches a paper attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Azural_Skill_Normal_Enhance_01_Desc:
After <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to two attacks, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
en.Azural_Skill_Normal_Enhance_02_Desc:
With <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Delivers a forward martial salute attack. On activation, it consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color> and deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After activation, the previous character's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_Normal_Title: Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service
en.Azural_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches consecutive kicks against enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Azural_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Azural_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Throws dual rings to slash enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Azural_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>. If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.4</color> for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> becomes <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color> for 8s.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> becomes <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> for 8s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> effect. While under <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color>, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. Before recovering from Stun, <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> per second. When a heavy attack of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits enemies, she gains 7.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>, when Dialyn triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window using <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Welcome Mat</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Forward Call</color>, the next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>. When an ally launches an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> this way, Dialyn consumes 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>.
With at least 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>, when Dialyn hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color> and doesn't trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window, she consumes 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> to forcibly trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window. The next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.
Each time <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> reaches 90 or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color>. A maximum of 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color> can be held at a time.

en.BanYue_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, when Banyue consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> through a Basic Attack branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color>. en.BanYue_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_AssaultAid_Light_Desc:
After successfully parrying an enemy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Immovable Mountain</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Executes a series of attacks against enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Counter_Desc:
After a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered through <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Overcome Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or after a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered though <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a forward attack that deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Evade_Taunt_Desc:
Rotate the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} in a half-circle and press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Dodges backward and taunts enemies.
After any <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> and quickly execute the required inputs during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> to then follow up with the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Banyue has more than 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, he automatically enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws a mountain, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Enhance_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline when using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out an even larger mountain, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Enhance_Title: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:

Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> in sequence to activate:
Banyue sends out a sonic wave forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Enhance_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline when using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: One's Path</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> in sequence to activate:
Banyue releases a powerful sonic wave in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Enhance_Title: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_04_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_Cancel_Desc:
When Banyue activates an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> ALT through quick input commands, the currently activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> can be interrupted. Each <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> has its own Perfect Interrupt window. Interrupting an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> after its Perfect Interrupt window will not affect the interrupted <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>'s effect. Interrupting an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> during the Perfect Interrupt window is equal to triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Cancel</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Cancel</color> is easier to trigger.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_Defense_Desc:
While attacking, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> without moving the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to activate:
Banyue enters a defensive stance. If attacked during this time, he parries the enemy's attack and accumulates Daze.
If attacked at the exact moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Block occurs.
Character is invulnerable during a successful parry.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_Charge_Desc:
While not in combat and with more than 50% HP and less than 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Banyue consumes HP to recover <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. Upon reaching 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue immediately enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain one chance to use this skill. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once per 180s.
HP consumption will at most reduce Banyue's HP to 50% of Max HP.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_EnterAngry_Desc:
While not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and with at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to nearby enemies, then enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_FinalAttack_Desc:
When Banyue is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> and activate:
Banyue hurls a massive mountain at the enemy, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this move, Banyue exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_FinalAttack_Enhance_:
While Banyue is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and after performing two different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> through Basic Attack branches or quick input commands, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Banyue launches his beads forward to imprison enemies, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Banyue automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_Heavy_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_Light_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Banyue has more than 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, he automatically enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Rush_Desc:
During a dodge, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches beads forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.
en.BanYue_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> when parrying an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Immovable Mountain</color>, and recover 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. When he possesses at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state by using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue can no longer gain <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. After Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, he exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue gains 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>. If Banyue has <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>, launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, remove all <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>.
When possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch four different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color> in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, he increases his Sheer Force by <color=#2BAD00>150</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color>, and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
