en.Brujas_UniqueSkill_Title: Core Passive: Taming Wind and Fire
en.Burnice_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
When Burnice's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color> hits an enemy, or when the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is triggered, the move's accumulated <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color> increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.
en.Burnice_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Leap into the air and quickly spin forward while spraying flames in all directions, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a flurry of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_BeHitAid_UpGrade_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks at enemies ahead and sprays flames, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When leaping into the air, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is activated, Burnice will extend the duration of her flame spray.
Upon activation, recover 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable during sidestep dodge and fire blast.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Title: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_01_UpGrade_Desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 60%.
Character is invulnerable during sidestep dodge and fire blast.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
While using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Use both flamethrowers to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration.
Character is invulnerable during the moment the spray is activated and during the activation of the fire blast.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Title: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_02_UpGrade_Desc:
While using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Use both flamethrowers to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration.
Character is invulnerable during the moment the spray is activated and during the activation of the fire blast.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 60%.
en.Burnice_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Spin continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move that inflicts <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
When the move is activated, it consumes 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>;
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Normal_Enhance_UpGrade_Des:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Spins continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move, then triggers an extra instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> that doesn't cost <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> and deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
The DMG dealt by this skill also counts as <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG.
Upon activation, it consumes 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Quickly dash forward while spraying flames in all directions, then launch a fire blast in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a forward rush attack with the flamethrower, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleash a fire blast forward, inflicting <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>;
Press and hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to charge, boosting the move's power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_Special_Title: Special Attack: Intense Heat Aging Method
en.Burnice_Skill_UpGrade_02_Desc:
If Burnice has <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, coming on-field activates this skill.
After squadmates trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>. With <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Quick Assist. When <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> triggered by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color> hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, the counter no longer increases. Consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color> clears the counter.
Quickly dashes forward and passes through the enemy, unleashing a fiery impact that deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the skill's heavy attack hits a target suffering <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>480%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>240%</color>/<color=#FF5521>600%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>40%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>60%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>24%</color> of the original Anomaly's DMG.
The <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color> increase from Additional Ability: Fire Kindling applies to this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_UpGrade_02_Title: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Tossing Method
en.Burnice_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state until all <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glorious Inferno</color>, she applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> effect to the target until she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state. When other squad members hit enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> status, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, expending 8 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>175%</color> of Burnice's ATK and accumulate <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG.

At 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state until all <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glorious Inferno</color>, she applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> effect to the target until she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state. When other squad members hit enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> status, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, expending 8 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>320%</color> of Burnice's ATK and accumulate <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG.

en.Caesar_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:

en.Caesar_Skill_Counter_Desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, followed by a powerful thrust, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an <color=#FFFFFF>Interrupt</color> is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating incoming damage once and countering with a shield attack. After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> without consuming energy.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks the attack and is knocked back. Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> and activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

en.Harumasa_MathSkill_Desc:

en.Harumasa_Skill_AimAttack_Desc:
After the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, or a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:

After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
en.Harumasa_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

en.Harumasa_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_Counter_Desc:

en.Harumasa_Skill_Evade_Desc:

en.Harumasa_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExQTE_Upgrade_Desc:
Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
Unleashes a wide-area piercing attack against enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. This is considered Ultimate DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Upgrade_Desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> after using the 4th/5th attack of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Braced Bow</color> to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field, firing <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the target's <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> stacks are close to the maximum, fewer <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Upgrade_Title: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol
en.Harumasa_Skill_FinishingSlash_Desc:
While there are <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, switching <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>. With less than 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> will be removed from the enemy. Before <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> is removed, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to repeatedly use <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>. While no <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Feather</color> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
en.Harumasa_Skill_FinishingSlash_Title: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
en.Harumasa_Skill_FinishingSlash_Upgrade_De:
While there are <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, switching <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rush forward to the closest <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Hitting a Stunned enemy triggers Chasing Thunder, dealing 1 instance of additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>. With less than 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> will be removed from the enemy. Before <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> is removed, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to repeatedly use <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>. While no <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Feather</color> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.
Enemy attacks can be blocked during the 1st hit of the skill. The pursuit effect of the second and third hits is increased.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
en.Harumasa_Skill_MoveAttack_Desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:

en.Harumasa_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
After activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color> and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.

en.Harumasa_Skill_Special_Desc:

en.Harumasa_Skill_TriggerAttack_Desc:
When the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>. If there are no <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> present at a time. If there are any <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will activate and fire <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the enemies hit by <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

While a target has at least 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, they will be <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color>.

en.HugoVlad_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The fourth attack is a shot. During this attack, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the fourth attack, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>, the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Phantasm - Slash</color>, or the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Elegy</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Throw the scythe forward to perform a slash, followed by a shot, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
During this skill, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_ParryAid_Title: Defensive Assist: The End Has Not Come
en.HugoVlad_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Trick of Fate</color> hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>25</color>/<color=#2BAD00>75</color>.
When the Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Blaspheme</color> hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by <color=#2BAD00>500%</color>. Additionally, the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>140%</color>; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>1,700%</color>.
After Hugo triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

en.JaneDoe_Enhance_Desc:
When Jane triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Upon reaching the maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>, Jane enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> regenerates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Jane exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state when all of her <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> is consumed.
en.JaneDoe_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> is increased by 20%. When the enemy is already suffering from an Attribute Anomaly, Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color> towards the target is increased by an additional 15%.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Leap up and swiftly slash the enemy, then execute a wide sweeping slash across a large area in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_BeHitAid_Enhance_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, when the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_Branch_Desc:
Entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state grants Jane one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>.
When available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to extend the skill duration. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
Using and damaging an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state generates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_Branch_Upgrade_Desc:
Entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state grants Jane one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>.
When available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to greatly extend the skill duration. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is Invulnerable during the Finishing Move and can trigger Perfect Dodge.
If Perfect Dodge is triggered, the amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> restored when the Finishing Move hits an enemy is increased.
Using and damaging an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state generates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
If after the first dodge, unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If after the second dodge, leap up and deliver three consecutive attacks to enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_Counter_Enhance_Desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_Evade_Desc:

A quick slide dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Jane has an extra dodge. Before she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, she alternates between the two dodges. After entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane can pass through enemies in front when dodging.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:

Weaves between and slashes enemies with a powerful attack in a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Jane directly enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state upon activating the skill, and gains max <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

en.Lighter_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Lighter automatically gains <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>, up to a maximum of 100. When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> runs out, Lighter will leave the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, keeping any unspent <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>.

en.Lucia_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
This Ultimate is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> lasts 8s. While inside <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.01+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*0.0005,100,2}%</color> of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. If she is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state when activating this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she will gain 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and re-enter <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.
en.Lucia_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When Lucia uses any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:5+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.2,1,1}</color> Sheer Force. The <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:612+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*24,1,2}</color>, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.34+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.03,100,2}%</color> of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and under the effect of <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

While in <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> or she leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.

en.Lycaon_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When Lycaon charges his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> to completion, the attack deals <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> increased Daze.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG RES</color> decreases by 25% for 30s.
en.Lycaon_UniqueSkill_01_Upgrade_Desc:
When Lycaon completes charging during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, or activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> has available activations, hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Lycaon enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance is gained. Up to 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation can be stored.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends, Lycaon automatically activates <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>6%</color>.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Lycaon will end the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state early.
When Lycaon manually uses <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state also ends early, but <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> will not be automatically triggered.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, Lycaon will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
When the active character performs a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>. After performing a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> duration does not decrease.

en.NangongYu_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
Any squad member's attack against a Stunned enemy has 30% increased Anomaly Buildup. <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomaly Buildup.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration. With <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Emergency Save</color> hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> is consumed to trigger the special <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, which will always trigger precise charging.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.
When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the attack, 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> will also be consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> on all enemies who meet the conditions.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Meteor Shower</color> hits an enemy, the enemy suffers <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color>. Under this effect, Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Stun duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Stun, <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Stun duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> recovers from Stun, the <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> effect ends.

en.NangongYu_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:

en.NangongYu_Skill_Branch_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a charged attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. Release the button at the right moment to trigger precise charging, increasing the Daze dealt by the skill by 20%.
Nangong Yu can perform up to three hits. The second and third hits each must consume 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>.
After using a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, if enough <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> are available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to skip the first hit and directly perform the second and third hits, which always trigger precise charging.
When Nangong Yu is the active character, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimates</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> do not interrupt the combo count of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>.
While charging the first hit, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken decreases by 60%.
While charging the second and third hits, the character is Invulnerable.
During the dash phase of the first hit, enemy attacks can be Blocked. On a successful Block, the attack is treated as a precise charging attack.
Character is invulnerable during all attacks.
en.NangongYu_Skill_Counter_Desc:

en.NangongYu_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:

Upon activating this skill, Nangong Yu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. If Nangong Yu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> again, the current <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> will first deactivate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Delivers a morning star attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

en.NangongYu_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>60</color>.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, or if the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> and recovers from being Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> stacks will be cleared.

During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.

Nangong Yu can have up to 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>, and starts with 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> upon entering the battlefield.

en.Norano_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes of an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.
en.Norano_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_AssaultAid_Title: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
en.Norano_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_Counter_Title: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
en.Norano_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
en.Norano_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
During each slash, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Special> triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
en.Norano_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
While in the Molten Edge state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will be consumed.
en.Norano_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Title: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
en.Norano_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, inflicting massive Daze and dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Gain 75 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_ParryAid_Title: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
en.Norano_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a shoulder slam forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Norano_Skill_Special_02_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color>. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_Special_02_Title: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
en.Norano_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Norano_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, he accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, Manato enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato consumes 3.3 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> per second. When <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> is fully depleted, he exits <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> are enhanced, and he can use <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall</color>.
When consuming HP during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes from an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.

en.Promeia_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Promeia's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When any squad member applies the <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.
When Promeia's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> on a target with <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color> lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
en.Promeia_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_Branch_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Promeia leaps into the air and attacks, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
en.Promeia_Skill_Buff_Desc:
When using certain skills, Promeia throws her cape to continuously slice enemies, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> upon hit.
While the cape remains out, Promeia can walk slowly.
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> during this period to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
If attacked during this period, Promeia triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> automatically. The dodge can trigger once every 20s.
en.Promeia_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches a series of forward attacks, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing 250% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs a flying blade attack, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
If attacked by an enemy shortly after using the move, automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>.
Upon use, Promeia gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Title: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
Triggers automatically when hit shortly upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death</color>:
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> state briefly and swiftly circles behind the enemy.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, and with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 40 Energy and activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, gaining the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Title: EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Desc:
While under the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state to activate:
Leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a descending attack that deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing, if Promeia possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_04_Desc:
After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly launches a flurry of attacks, then leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a more powerful downward attack that deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing, if Promeia possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_06_Desc:
With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> and after performing the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> after landing to activate:
Quickly leaps back while unleashing a more powerful finishing move, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
After using this skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special>, or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_06_Title: EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
en.Promeia_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing the fifth hit's downward attack, and with sufficient <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state after throwing the cape during the fourth hit.
en.Promeia_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws flying blades and hangs upside down above the enemy, unleashing a flurry of attacks and ending with a finishing move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing 100% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick attack forward, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
en.Promeia_Skill_Special_01_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a flying blade attack, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
en.Promeia_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> when her attacks hit enemies. When squad members trigger <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, when the enemy is inflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, or when Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she gains an additional 5/5/5/10 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, Promeia gains an additional 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> reaches at least 50, 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> is consumed and converted into 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, up to a maximum of 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
When the finishing move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing <color=#2BAD00>330%</color> Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. The skill consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> upon activation.
When Promeia triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, she gains an additional 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. Using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color> grants <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>. With <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>, after using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to consume <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> and immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> can be held.

en.Seed_MathSkill_Desc:
When another <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Character is in your squad:
When Seed deals DMG as the active character, restore 2 Energy to the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color> deal 30% increased DMG and ignore 25% of enemy <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.
en.Seed_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash continuous floating turret attacks at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_BeHitAid_Title: Quick Assist: Barrage of Raining Flowers
en.Seed_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, accumulate 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Enter flight mode, where Seed can move in four directions, and unleash a continuous barrage of missiles, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy.
During flight, release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away</color>.
Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ExSpecial_Final_Desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals</color>, release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash rapid cannon fire, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ExSpecial_Final_Title: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
en.Seed_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
en.Seed_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> for the first two hits and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.
en.Seed_Skill_Normal_Robot_01_Desc:
After the 4th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, hold or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> by holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal>. This effect expires when <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> once.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_Normal_Robot_02_Desc:
Seed has <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills.
<color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> and triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> and unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form</color>, then automatically consume 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> to follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form</color>.
Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Summons her mech for protection, then launches cannon shots and a barrage of missiles, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_QTE_Title: Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals
en.Seed_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Throw steel wheels forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Seed_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Throw a steel wheel that traces a curved path, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
en.Seed_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
The <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Seed gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status, increasing Seed's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When Seed unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status, increasing the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>'s ATK by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> are both active, Seed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> simultaneously gain <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, increasing DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>, Seed immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, while the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status.
<color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.

Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

Upon activating this skill, consume 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The squad can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> once every 3s.

Upon activating this skill, consume 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> will immediately activate instead if triggered.
en.Trigger_Skill_Normal_ChargeAttack_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Trigger enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> and fires forward continuously, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.
